name: gigai-api-worker
description: Task worker for the GigAI Developer API. Bundled with esbuild, deployed as one file (sharp stays external - native, installed on the server).

scripts.build: esbuild worker.mjs --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node22 --external:pg-native --external:sharp --external:svgo --external:@napi-rs/canvas --outfile=worker.bundle.mjs --banner:js="import { createRequire as __gigaiCR } from 'node:module'; const require = __gigaiCR(import.meta.url);"
